api.execution: Read-only deterministic validation/proposals in existing workflow_assurance.py. Read declared local artifacts/Git objects/environment; never execute receipt commands, write files/state, contact network, start subprocess commands other than existing read-only Git helpers, or add CLI/scheduler/state store. plan always invokes actual receipt validation internally, not a forgeable caller-supplied passed token.
api.reuse: Reuse json_value/parse_json/canonical/relative_path/regular_file, validate_identity/compare_identity, immutable Git helpers and verify_record_update. Validate immutable approved contracts with schema/contract.schema.json, contract-review with schema/contract_review.schema.json, fresh QA with evolved schema/qa_verdict.schema.json and input/output run state with schema/run_state.schema.json via jsonschema; strict relational/type checks additionally apply. Other kinds below have explicit local closed predicates, not invented shipped schemas. Existing validate.sh/verify_lib.sh remain repository validation authority; no schema or existing helper edits.
api.trust_boundary: Trusted Root supplies independently selected policy and producer/artifact expectations from an approved contract and actual operator authority. Receipt contents cannot select their own expectations. Local recorded producer IDs, SHA256, Git objects and schemas establish structure/binding/integrity, not authentication, consent or execution attestation. Caller is responsible for trusted capture/transport and observing candidate/environment; APIs neither authenticate humans nor claim protection from a malicious caller controlling policy and artifacts.
api.policy_shape: Exact object: schema_version(integer1), repository, feature_id, stage, operation_id, candidate(existing115 identity), contract(artifact reference), operator(artifact reference), producer(exact nonempty agent_id/session_id object), prerequisites(ordered entries below), commands(ordered entries below), from_status, to_status, at(nonempty timestamp), recovery(null or artifact reference). from_status/to_status are explicit nonempty strings chosen by trusted policy; run_state schema itself imposes no status enum. Stages limited to contract-approved/source-ready/qa-passed/evidence-captured/feature-complete. Artifact reference exact path/sha256/revision fields: canonical regular relative path, lowercase64hex digest, real lowercase40hex immutable Git commit; read historical bytes at that revision, verify actual digest and regular Git mode. No automatic live-file equality for historical authority. Current output files additionally use safe regular_file validation. Policy is independently frozen/reviewed, never selected by receipt.
api.receipt_shape: Exact object: schema_version(integer1), repository, feature_id, stage, operation_id, status, candidate(existing115 identity), producer, contract_ref, operator_ref, prerequisites, checks, verdict. Bindings equal policy exactly. status enum pending/running/passed/failed/invalidated; only passed advances. Each check exact argv,executed,outcome,exit_code,stdout,stderr,capture; argv string array, executed exactbool, exit_code exactinteger or null, outcome success/semantic-negative/unrun/setup-error/unsupported/transport-error/failed, output/capture references immutable artifact refs. verdict exact final_verdict/issues/missing_acceptance_coverage/unsupported_claims keys; final_verdict may retain JSON metadata but approved exactbool. Finite acyclic exact JSON objects; no coercion/default approval.
api.candidate_binding: Validate both candidate identities with existing115 validator and require compare_identity true, including repository/source commit/tree/source-contract-test-tool assessed digests/environment/record masks. Require actual immutable source commit/tree exists and each protected source/test/tool file bytes/mode matches the bound Git object and assessed digest; contract authority is read at its immutable approved reference, not required to remain byte-identical after Root lifecycle metadata completion. Trusted policy must bind all relevant assessed inputs; unknown dependencies invalidate. Current observed protected objects/environment must match; do not substitute ambient HEAD for assessed revision. Evidence-only descendants may change HEAD without invalidation when protected inputs remain identical and only explicitly declared record ownership applies; do not require HEAD==base or rewrite old seals.
api.authority: policy.contract references an actual immutable approved contract: existing schema valid, contract_id==feature_id==policy.feature_id, status exactly approved, approvals.validator_mode_a and evaluator_contract_review exactlyTrue. Its approval_evidence must identify mode_a/contract_review artifact paths and proposal_sha256. Independently pinned corresponding entries must exist as described below; both bind that same proposal digest and actual distinct recorded reviewer identities. Read approved historical bytes even if live Root contract metadata is now complete; do not compare historical proposal gates to a future Source candidate. policy.operator references the concrete Root application below, selected against real existing standing authority; no new human approval is inferred or requested. Receipt producer equals independently expected agent/session, a recorded provenance assertion rather than authentication.
api.prerequisites: Every entry exact kind,artifact,feature_id,assessed_revision,contract_sha256; artifact is immutable ref, feature_id nonempty string, assessed_revision real40hex commit, contract_sha256 lowercase64hex. Kinds only mode-a/contract-review/approved-contract/provisional-bundle/mode-b/fresh-qa/evidence-capture. Fixed minima: contract-approved needs mode-a+contract-review; source-ready approved-contract+provisional-bundle; qa-passed mode-b; evidence-captured fresh-qa; feature-complete fresh-qa+evidence-capture. All additionally declared entries conjunctive; duplicates reject. Required current-stage kinds must feature_id==policy.feature_id; historical predecessor entries may be additional only, keep their own explicitly expected feature/revision/contract digest and cannot satisfy a current minimum. Receipt entries equal independently pinned policy entries. Per-kind predicates below are mandatory, not caller-overridable expected shapes.
api.actual_execution: Each policy command exact argv,expected_exit,proof_kind,diagnostic,capture fields; expected_exit exactinteger0, proof_kind success or semantic-negative, diagnostic nonempty exact output line, capture immutable independently selected reference. Receipt check.capture must equal policy capture, never authorize by its own selected result. Read closed capture record below and require strict executedTrue, actual exit_code==policy.expected_exit==receipt.exit_code==0, argv/order, producer, candidate/environment and outcome==policy.proof_kind across all three. Output refs in receipt equal capture stdout/stderr refs; pinned actual bytes/digests verified, expected diagnostic must appear as exact line. No missing/duplicate checks. A forged passed/exit0/PASS-text receipt cannot override pinned capture nonzero/unrun/setup/unsupported/transport result. Success and semantic-negative here describe a successfully executed assertion command, not permission for process failure. Old intentional-negative receipt formats remain unchanged and outside this new closed capture profile.

Authority repository must equal policy.repository or policy.repository+" only". Phase IDs, actor names, gate IDs and numerical allowances come from these independently pinned artifacts, never public algorithm constants. Current phase018, /root, H-PHASE-018 and7200/9360 remain repository dogfood fixture values only; other consistently pinned authorized scopes are valid. Reuse actual standing authority without requiring an invented approved field there. Automated gate cannot replace the nonempty human instruction authority; normalized application records bounded Root interpretation, while hashes/schema/role labels do not authenticate consent.
api.artifact_predicates: mode-a: strict AGF gate plus artifact.feature==entry.feature_id, reviewed_commit==assessed_revision, contract_sha256==entry.contract_sha256 and nonempty reviewer. contract-review: existing contract_review schema plus strict AGF, feature/contract_id==entry.feature_id, reviewed_revision==assessed_revision, proposal_sha256==entry.contract_sha256, nonempty reviewer or actor (exactly one expected field selected by actual artifact, if both present values must agree). approved-contract: existing contract schema, status approved, IDs match, dual approvals exactTrue, artifact digest==entry.contract_sha256, artifact revision==entry.assessed_revision and actual dual pinned gate refs as authority. provisional-bundle: strict AGF plus feature_id,reviewed_revision,approved_contract_sha256 equal entry and nonempty reviewer. mode-b: strict AGF plus feature,reviewed_commit,approved_contract_sha256 equal entry and nonempty reviewer. fresh-qa: evolved QA schema plus strict AGF, qa_pass exactTrue, feature_id/reviewed_revision/approved_contract_sha256 equal entry, checks_run/checks_passed exactpositive integers equal, adversarial.performed exactTrue. evidence-capture: actual Root artifact role==Root, feature/revision/approved_contract_sha256 equal entry, passed exactTrue and actual_exit exactinteger0; no AGF arrays invented for capture. AGF strict means final_verdict.approved is True and three arrays exactly empty; unknown kinds/shape or ambiguous binding fields reject. Schemas allow existing metadata; mandatory binding fields/predicates cannot be overridden.
api.capture_profile: New normalized immutable capture record exact schema_version(integer1),argv,cwd,revision,candidate_sha256,environment,producer,executed,outcome,exit_code,stdout,stderr. cwd nonempty actual string, revision real immutable executed commit, candidate_sha256 SHA256 canonical policy candidate, environment exact candidate.environment observed runtime/variables, producer exact expected agent/session, executed exactbool and outcome/exit preserve actual capture result even on failure; stdout/stderr immutable refs. Require executed revision descends from policy candidate.source_commit and protected source/test/tool objects match policy assessed digests/modes at both revisions. Observed current protected files/environment still checked; an evidence-only HEAD advance is allowed without substituting HEAD. Capture pins supplied independently by trusted Root transport; API cannot infer authenticity of an attacker-controlled capture. Compute SHA256 of canonical complete receipt and canonical115 candidate identity. Return exactly action,state,receipt,reason. For advance deep-copy state, set status=policy.to_status and updated_at=policy.at, append exactly {at,event:"wa-receipt-transition",detail,operation_id,feature_id,stage,candidate_sha256,receipt_sha256}; detail is exactly "Receipt " + operation_id + " advanced " + feature_id + ":" + stage + " (" + receipt_sha256 + ")". Require state.status==policy.from_status. Verify only /status,/updated_at,/history through existing verify_record_update; validate output schema too. Root alone applies corresponding canonical lifecycle/evidence then derived state; no implicit feature completion/atomic cross-file write.
api.idempotence: Search existing history for event wa-receipt-transition and operation_id across all stages/candidates. Exactly one full expected event including deterministic detail and state.status==to_status returns noop with state unchanged and independent copies, output schema valid. Same operation reused for different receipt/candidate/stage, duplicate events, altered detail or incompatible current status rejects. Unowned fields, counters, budgets, authority and entire old history prefix preserved. Identity uses immutable candidate/receipt digest, never current HEAD.
api.recovery: receipt=None never means passed. Without recovery ref return rerun-required, unchanged schema-valid state, receipt null and explicit reason. With ref read exact independently pinned historical approved receipt and verify all normal policy/actual capture obligations; any existing same operation event must match canonical recovered receipt digest/full identity. Return republish with unchanged state and verified receipt only; no publication/advance has occurred. Missing recovery artifact returns rerun-required; corrupt/unsafe/mismatched rejects. Root or owned acceptance fixture actually restores exact original bytes at declared destination, then re-reads/revalidates and calls normal planner: advance once or noop if recorded. AT11 must exercise that actual restore/revalidation, not only inspect republish label. No invented proof, command execution, retries or counter resets; original failures stay actual.

verification.acceptance_test: AT1 reject-missing-operator: valid scoped standing-authorization application passes; absent/wrong-target/nonbool operator fails.
AT2 reject-wrong-candidate: exact assessed candidate and permitted evidence-only HEAD continuity pass; changed protected objects/environment or different receipt target rejects.
AT3 reject-unrun: actual independently expected command/exit/output proof passes; unexecuted/null/absent proof cannot pass despite passed label.
AT4 reject-setup: legitimate actual success passes; setup/unsupported/transport outcome or expected_exit manipulation cannot authorize advancement.
AT5 reject-pending: pending remains nonpassing; restored complete actual receipt passes.
AT6 reject-running: running remains nonpassing; restored complete actual receipt passes.
AT7 reject-failed: failed/nonzero/strict-type wrong exit remains failure; restored actual success passes.
AT8 reject-invalidated: invalidated/stale prerequisite receipt rejects; valid bound fresh receipt passes.
AT9 idempotent-replay: real valid first proposal advances once; same complete receipt yields noop with identical history/status and no alias/input mutation.
AT10 reject-double-advance: conflicting same operation ID, duplicate event, changed stage/candidate/receipt or incompatible current state rejects; legitimate identical replay remains noop.

AT11 recover-missing-receipt: missing proof produces unchanged rerun-required; exact pinned valid artifact yields republish only; restored receipt advances once/noops if recorded, corrupt/wrong artifact rejects.
